other_experiments.status: Intermediate diagnostic sources, not final acceptance. heap/plan/fused/inline/inline-write/selected labels precede the raw-entry layout regression. Plan, fused and inline variants using static layout hints were rejected. Fully inlined reads/writes also increased cold 1000-case cost to about 1.7 seconds.
other_experiments.cache_correction: An initial exploratory plan invocation accidentally reused an older experimental helper ABI cache and failed. It was excluded. Subsequent measurements and every accepted invocation use independent cold caches.
